rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT calculations using GGA-PBE with a plane-wave pseudopotential method; multiple steps (relaxation, Birch-Murnaghan EOS fitting, finite-strain elastic constants) are well-documented and routine in computational materials science, but require non-trivial implementation and understanding of convergence and post-processing.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline (6 declared steps) with dependencies: building structures, zero-pressure relaxation, pressure sweeps (~10 pressures each), EOS fitting, finite-strain elastic constant runs, and final JSON assembly. Requires managing ~30-40 DFT jobs, data extraction, and regression fitting, which is non-trivial orchestration.

Resources are modest: small unit cells, moderate plane-wave cutoff, no GPU needed.
